057.body: MAINLINE-057 filed, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. Once a sourced concept-stage mass-growth allowance is carried, no hull size from R10 to R30 floats, for either lead, in ISA or optimistic weather, at any of the 16 optimism subsets with every axis at its endpoint. The table is NASA GSFC IDC Table VI-1, adapted from AIAA S-120-2006 (S-120A and SAWE RP 7 are paywalled): calculated structure 15%, estimated hardware 30%, thermal 20%. Allocations (100 kg systems, gas, contamination, vacuum service), the water film, weather headroom and P3's sag debit carry none; the finish's own +10% and P3's joint allowance are credited. At R10, P2's +118.7 kg becomes -588.7 (MGA 707 kg) and P3's +30.9 becomes -649.7 (681 kg). R10 tolerates only 2.8% (P2) and 0.7% (P3) flat growth on hardware, so it needs flight-proven masses. Tolerance rises with radius: P2 reaches 9.9% at R30 ISA (6.3% optimistic), P3 7.5% (5.0%). R30 is the least-bad design point: it floats at TRL 7-8 allowances (5-6%), never at the 15-30% a concept carries. R20 is the smallest size where P2 floats in both weathers at TRL 7. The allowance costs more optimism than exists: the least sets' usage would need 1.78-2.13 (P2) and 4.6-30 (P3), linearly extrapolated. P2's R20/R30 bills are 040's with 048's finish transferred, checked within 0.2-9.2 kg at R10-15. Sensitivity gives payload at R10/12/15/20/30 against flat 0-30%. Eight NFI. Next: none.

check057.body:
CHECK-057 complete, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. Independently reconstructed 1,232 subset bills across 77 configurations; 82,034 final comparisons. Under the declared conventions, every concept-stage payload remains negative. R10 MGA reproduces 707.388727 kg for P2 and 680.594681 kg for P3.

One correction changes maturity: the card specifies direct 048 bills at R10–15 but its tables use 040 transfers. Direct 048 gives P2 R12 ISA +1.256483 kg at TRL 7, versus transfer −0.839968 kg. The first floating row changes from TRL 8 to TRL 7.

The finish allowance uses the wrong denominator; corrected P2 R10 MGA is 707.293535 kg. The 0.2–9.2 kg transfer-error range applies only to masks 11/15; all 96 comparisons reach 160.754744 kg. Four printed cells have one-kilogram rounding errors. Exact 3,193 correction entries are pinned.

R10 growth tolerances 2.8/0.7% and R30 ISA 9.9/7.5% reproduce. All 28 item classes and zero-growth allocations were audited. Sixteen NFI dispositions retain maturity, reserves, classification, transfer and domain limitations. Qualified hull SF, failure probability and maturity remain null.

All 173 package checks pass; 36 input pins and the 137-file manifest verify. Six one-core/1 GiB simjob invocations admitted and released; no refusals. No owner code or out-of-band contact.

Resubmitted under the untimed replacement order. The scientific package is unchanged; refused envelopes are preserved. Next none.

058.body: MAINLINE-058 filed, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. My own P2 model reproduces 050's five fixed hulls exactly; P3 comes from 052's rows. Two levers widen the band. Relief: size the hull for the -30 hPa day, then climb (or admit air) above it. The worst-corner hot edge rises 11.9-12.0 K for P2 and 6.4-6.6 K for P3, P2's hull is 4.5-4.7% lighter, and there is no upper pressure limit. A low-emittance finish (Al with acrylic overcoat, eps 0.05) moves P2's clear-night cold edge 11 K lower for 0.2-0.5% of mass. Inside the whole bill, P2's worst-corner band widens from 4.0 to 25.7 K at R10 and from 13.8 to 34.6 K at R30. Trim air cannot be pumped out in flight (034's pumps take 11 days to 1.5 years); on the ground it costs 17-19 h per flight day. Climbing needs up to 510 m, ballast 0.2-0.4 t at R10. Thrust buys about 0.6 K for an hour, a kite helps only tethered hulls, shade nothing. At London Heathrow 2014-2023, 24-hour days covered: P2 R10 34% as built, 64% relieved, 84% with the finish, R12 96%; P3 sized at standard pressure and climbing, 78% (R10) and 97% (R12). 95% of days needs R12 with gamma/Q/film (P2) or S/F/J (P3); 99% needs R20 (P2) or R15 (P3). No relieved hull reaches a MIL-HDBK-310 hot day at R30 or below (10%: P3 0.9 t short, P2 3.0-3.9 t). All of this assumes flight-proven masses (057). 17 NFI. Next: none.

047.body:
MAINLINE-047 filed with CHECK-029 folded in. QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION.

The criterion is min(endpoint, first face yield, first core shear). The 255/300 MPa cases fail even at zero dimple. With assumed 345 MPa faces, the governing tested pass–fail brackets are 1.209–1.227 mm at SF1 and 0.738–0.756 mm at SF1.05; single-Gaussian RMS estimates 14.32/8.78 micrometres.

These results explicitly use orthotropic StVK core E_in=1 MPa, G_in=.5 MPa, inherited radial/transverse moduli, and catalog minimum-average/typical shear strengths. The inherited .01-MPa core is not accepted after CHECK-029's ellipticity finding. The stronger regularization is unsourced: no actual-hull tolerance is qualified.

New native core stress/strain fields check current-frame shear and local ellipticity on passing paths. Face yield governs the small-dimple limits; larger dimples encounter material limits before numerical endpoints. Both meridians and all four footprints are covered.

Conditional endpoint division by 1.10 gives a common SF1 bracket 0.521–0.539 mm; SF1.05 then fails even at zero. Transferring 2.31–2.46x permits none. CHECK-029 identifies a foam-law artifact behind that larger gap, so these are rejection scenarios, not empirical calibration.

Cure debit, controls, 015b/042 comparisons and inherited-law sensitivities are retained. 319 native records, 1892 checks, 14 NFIs. Retry and keep-turn-open orders observed. No successor; stop and file.

054.body:
MAINLINE-054 complete — QUESTIONABLE / PROJECTION throughout. Reproduced least-root ingress 1.258056 kg/day and 17.279789 h humidity crossing; schedule 15.551810 h.

At 052 favourable endpoints, R10 ISA MET alone supports the conditional one-day screen with +30.71 kg payload. Seven-day SiOx/3A gives +1.12 kg: 17.16 kg beads, 27.23 kg capture system, 2.51 kg barrier increment. Thirty days gives −55.43 kg. Net working capacity is 6 wt% with bed ≤333 K; seven days requires about 277 m3/h effective water conductance and 16.54 W peak heat rejection. Doubling WVTR makes that payload −15.09 kg.

Thirty-day SiOx/3A gives R12 ISA +110.83 kg and R15 optimistic +180.67 kg; passive foil30 alternatives give +47.35/+77.60 kg. R12 optimistic SiOx/3A fails at −74.55 kg; both-weather fails throughout. Thin ALD/ML3 remains an unverified carrier/flex transfer, not an installed-service result.

Aramid same-gauge SF is 0.517/0.310 for yarn/60%-efficiency bounds; resizing is charged. UHMWPE fails the 30-day, 1%-creep screen at the cited 900 MPa/30 C condition.

First grounding route: metallised seamed-panel testing, then HX/cartridge transport and thermal demonstration. Full bills, source conditions, regeneration, defect sensitivities, 16 new and 15 inherited NFI included. 5,949 assertions pass; 88 frozen pins verified. Seven scientific invocations admitted/released; no refusal. No successor started.

017b.body:
MAINLINE-017b filed. From today's values (handbook gamma 0.20, wrinkle 0.33, stock panels, SR-200 faces on CR-III 5056 3/8-1.0, 028's joining replacing the 5% allowance, 019's reserve scaled by 027), P2 is 0.528 at R 10 m and 0.571 at R 20 m; global buckling binds. Only three properties reach SF 1 alone: a face 1.87/1.73 times lighter at beryllium's stiffness and strength; gamma x4.06/x3.41 (0.81/0.68, a 2.5/13 mm dimple by 015's map); face modulus x2.04/x1.93, only at the fragile Vc 2 step. Core stiffness, flatness, sheet size, film and seams are not alone. Cheapest: the lighter face alone; keeping Be, gamma alone; keeping Be and handbook values, a core stiffer than aluminium can be (product 13.1/9.5).

P3 today (Ti sleeves, Kapton) is 0.710; the projection row (CFRP wrap, Zylon) floats at 1.441. Today's row reaches 1 alone on tube specific stiffness x1.41 (beyond SiC), lattice knockdown x1.99 or film specific strength x3.79. Every P3 route needs a qualified SiC compressive strength of 0.83-1.20 GPa; none exists.

Trends: beryllium, aluminium honeycomb, SiC and the knockdown and wrinkling design values are flat for 30+ years; Be sheet shrank. Only film specific strength moves (2.2%/yr since 1975, 4.1% since 1999): Upilex-S gives x2.17 already, the rest in 14-25 years if it held (PROJECTION). Closest: P3 via film. Step changes: the lighter face, tube stiffness, a large-sphere knockdown, a stiffer core, lattice tests. 34 reproduction checks pass; 15 NFI rows; files pinned. The brief names no next job.

048.body:
QUESTIONABLE / PROJECTION. MAINLINE-048 complete: 432 configurations, four finishes, three drying routes, actual/retained-floor joining, weather cases and separate dry-exterior sensitivities.

At R10 ISA with the retained floor, 200 F cure fix, 10 g/m2 extra structural primer and projected 90% material-water removal, endpoint payload is +124.262 kg for multilayer CCAg, +121.474 kg for classical CCAg, +17.403 kg for 0.5-mil Ag/FEP and -17.954 kg for 1-mil tape. Exterior water remains 125.664 kg. The primary least set is gamma/Q/film, usage 0.833076. Retained-water R10 weather cases still fail.

The lightest recipe is calculated at 7.5752 g/m2 before allowance; its optical transfer and Be installation remain unqualified. No qualified lightest finish is established. All candidate optics, thermal factors, durability and adhesion gaps are filed.

The 0.1 kg/m2 water debit traces to an assumed exterior liquid film, not sorption. Baking removes only 1.226 kg of the modeled extra R10 material water; onboard sorbent retains water and adds 28.646 kg. WVR and TML stay distinct.

213,078 checks on 7,149 points pass; 56 input/source pin records verified. Wet optics, process/life, cure and inherited hull qualifications remain open. Installed SF unknown. Stopping as brief directs.

048fold.body:
QUESTIONABLE / PROJECTION. CHECK-040’s water, cure-compression and bond findings are folded into 048 in 648 new configurations. Original filed artifacts remain unchanged.

At 1 mm retained exterior water, all 432 R10–15 cases fail to float, including all-four endpoints and favorable interior-optimism bounds. Best all-four payload is −998.333 kg; best favorable bound is −998.280 kg. Neither 0.1 nor 1 mm is a measured retention limit. No bake, dry-gas or sorbent route earns an exterior wet-service reduction; material water stays separately accounted.

Including cure compression in global/crimp demand reduces the multilayer R10 ISA bake endpoint from +124.262 to +118.695 kg; least set becomes G+Q+film usage .842794. Two previously floating marginal configurations lose every allowed set. CHECK-040’s original R15 optimistic all-four −1.821 kg case reproduces.

The 200°F source tests use AF163-2K .060 metal joints, EC-3924B and 50 psi. They do not qualify 2U .015 Be/honeycomb. Exact bond/process NFI is explicit. Thermal-table independent reproduction and all original qualifications remain open; installed-hull SF stays null.

130,278 checks pass across 10,469 distinct points. All 43 CHECK-040 cure targets reproduce within .000684 kg. Package verifies 69 pins. The separate 030d register order is now active.
